# Vayu Packaging Solutions

> Corrugated box and packaging materials supplier in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Custom sizes, 3, 5 and 7-ply boxes, printed and die-cut boxes, tapes, stretch film, bubble wrap and strapping. Also a free 3D box designer that folds a box on screen and exports a dieline and spec sheet.

- [Reduce Damage and RTO: A 12-Point Packing Checklist](https://vayupackaging.vercel.app/blogs/reduce-damage-rto-packing-checklist): A 12-point packing checklist to cut transit damage: right-size box, board by weight, void fill, tape, labels, photos and a test. Print it for your packers.
- [Packing Kesar Mangoes for Online Sale: 3, 5 and 10 kg](https://vayupackaging.vercel.app/blogs/pack-kesar-mangoes-online-sale): Pack Kesar mangoes for online sale: box sizes for 3, 5 and 10 kg worked from fruit count, with vents, hand holes and board. Trader or courier. Open in 3D.
- [Packing Pickle, Ghee and Spice Jars Without Leaks](https://vayupackaging.vercel.app/blogs/pack-pickle-ghee-spice-jars-courier): Pack pickle, ghee and spice jars for courier without leaks: seal, bag, wrap and box each jar, with carton sizes for 1 to 6 jars worked out. Open each in 3D.
